Thursday · Sept 10

Austin to Charlottesville

Flights American · conf. DUXCCY

AA1067Austin → Dallas · depart AUS 8:00 AM, arrive DFW 9:21 AM
Layover1 hr 2 min at DFW
Dallas → Richmonddepart DFW 10:23 AM, arrive RIC 2:23 PM

Afternoon

  • Collect luggage and rental car
  • Leave Richmond airport ~3:00 PM
  • Drive ~1 hr 15 min to Charlottesville
  • ~4:30 PM — check in at 100 Oakhurst Circle
Lodging — 100 Oakhurst Circle, Charlottesville VA

Carter Mountain Sunset Series 6:00–9:00 PM

  • Meet the family at Carter Mountain for the evening
  • The Mellow Dramatics playing live
  • Vision BBQ and Farmacy food trucks
  • Wine, Bold Rock cider, mountain views — dinner at the event
Advance tickets required. If the flight is delayed substantially, the backup is dinner with the family in Charlottesville.
Friday · Sept 11

Luray, Skyline Drive & Downtown Mall

Morning

  • 7:00 AM — Bodo's Bagels, UVA Corner location
  • 7:45–8:00 AM — leave Charlottesville
  • 9:15–9:30 AM — arrive at Luray Caverns

Luray Caverns

  • Tour the caverns — allow ~2 hours
  • Add time at the included museums if everyone's interested
  • Lunch around Luray
Open until 6:00 PM after Labor Day.

Skyline Drive

  • Enter Shenandoah at Thornton Gap, drive south to Swift Run Gap (~34 miles)
  • Stop at overlooks — don't try to drive the whole park
  • Return to Charlottesville ~4:30–5:00 PM
Vehicle entrance fee $30, covers everyone for 7 days.

Downtown Mall with family

  • ~5:30 PM — New Dominion Bookshop (open til 9 PM Fri)
  • ~6:15 PM — dinner on the Downtown Mall
  • ~7:30–9:30 PM — Decades Arcade (open til 10 PM)
New Dominion and Decades are practically next door.
Saturday · Sept 12

Colonial Williamsburg & the Riverhouse

Morning

  • 8:00 AM — Bodo's Bagels with family
  • Finish packing and check out
  • 8:45–9:00 AM — leave Charlottesville
  • ~10:45–11:00 AM — arrive in Williamsburg

Colonial Williamsburg — full day

  • Historic buildings and trade shops
  • Governor's Palace, the Capitol, Archaeology Center
  • Merchants Square and scheduled demonstrations
Most historic sites and trades run 10:00 AM–5:00 PM. The Archaeology Center is open Saturday (it would've been closed Monday).
Saturday extras: Williamsburg Farmers Market until noon, and the Merchants Square Fall Sidewalk Sale 10:00 AM–5:00 PM. You may catch the end of the market if you arrive early.
Colonial Williamsburg, VA

Evening — to the riverhouse

  • ~5:00 PM — finish Colonial Williamsburg
  • Dinner around Williamsburg or something easy for the road
  • Pick up the scheduled Walmart grocery order in Gloucester
  • Continue to the riverhouse and unload
Gloucester Walmart — 6819 Walton Lane, open until 11:00 PM. Assemble the order while still in Charlottesville and schedule it for Saturday evening. Store page
Pickup list: breakfast food · coffee & creamer · drinks & bottled water · snacks · easy meals · paper products · trash bags · cleaning supplies for Tuesday.
Sunday · Sept 13

Busch Gardens & Optional Jamestown Split

John's plan

  • Breakfast at the riverhouse
  • Leave early enough to arrive at Busch Gardens before opening
  • Full day at the park
  • Stay for Howl-O-Scream if desired
Howl-O-Scream begins at 6:00 PM and is included with park admission.

Mallori & her mom's decision

Option A · Busch Gardens

  • Everyone spends the day together at the park
  • Jamestown moves to Monday afternoon

Option B · Jamestown

  • Drop John at Busch Gardens, then visit:
  • Jamestown Glasshouse
  • Historic Jamestowne dig & Archaearium
  • Dale House Café if reopened
The Glasshouse runs 8:45 AM–4:30 PM with demonstrations throughout the day. They could shop, have dinner, or head back before the Howl-O-Scream pickup — that pickup is the main transport detail to coordinate. If Jamestown gets done Sunday, Monday becomes exceptionally relaxed.
Monday · Sept 14

Yorktown, the Boat & Relaxation

Preferred — if Jamestown was done Sunday

  • Sleep in, relaxed breakfast and coffee at the riverhouse
  • Leave ~10:00 AM, arrive Yorktown ~11:00 AM
  • Walk the historic town, waterfront, and Riverwalk Landing
  • Lunch at Yorktown Pub ~11:30 AM–noon
  • Return to the riverhouse early afternoon
  • Take the boat out for an unstructured cruise
  • Relax at the house the rest of the day
Yorktown Pub opens 11:00 AM Monday, no reservations. The boat ride needs no destination — 45 minutes or several hours depending on weather, water, and how everyone feels.

Alternate — if Jamestown wasn't done Sunday

  • Leave the riverhouse ~9:30 AM
  • Walk around Yorktown, early lunch at Yorktown Pub
  • Leave Yorktown ~12:30 PM
  • Jamestown Glasshouse and dig site ~1:15–3:30 PM
  • Drink or snack at the Dale House Café if open
  • Return to the riverhouse ~5:00 PM, shorter evening boat cruise, relax
Busier, but it still fits without making Jamestown feel rushed.
Tuesday · Sept 15

Clean the Riverhouse & Fly Home

Morning — closing the house

  • Breakfast
  • Finish packing
  • Clean kitchen and bathrooms
  • Strip beds / handle linens
  • Take out trash
  • Secure the boat and outdoor areas
  • Load the car
  • Final walkthrough
Pack most personal belongings Monday night so Tuesday morning is primarily cleaning.

Airport

  • Leave the riverhouse ~noon
  • Target Richmond airport ~1:30 PM
  • Drop Mallori's mom for her 3:00 PM flight
  • Return the rental car, check in for your flight
Dropping her at 1:30 PM is safer than 2:00 PM, especially if she checks luggage.
